rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install bh_unify_lib64_with_lib "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR"
# gdb only loads the script from here GDB_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gdb/auto-load/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" install -d -m 0755 "$GDB_DIR" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"*-gdb.py "$GDB_DIR"
# a macro to build isl itself, Debian does not package it either rm -r "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/aclocal"
